page_title: CHE 1-0 FUL | Chelsea v Fulham 13/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Anthony Taylor saw the whole situation.
90+5' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
90+3' Mauricio Pochettino has decided to substitute Malo Gusto and he is replaced by Alfie Gilchrist (Chelsea).
90+2' That will be all from Cole Palmer who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Carney Chukwuemeka (Chelsea).

90+1' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Bernd Leno shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!

86' Willian (Fulham) attempts to threaten the goalkeeper from the free kick on the edge of the box. He produces a stunning blast which only flies inches over the crossbar. It could have been a beautiful goal!
86' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) makes a strong challenge and Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
83' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) can't believe his eyes as he misses a big opportunity to convert a rebound. The ball brushes the left post.
83' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Joao Palhinha.
82' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Andreas Pereira is replaced by Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham).
82' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
81' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The linesman makes the right call and Chelsea will have a corner.
79' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
79' Thiago Silva (Chelsea) takes out his opponent with a horrific tackle and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
79' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
78' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The referee blows his whistle, Chelsea are awarded a corner kick.
77' That's the end of the game for Raheem Sterling, who is replaced by Ben Chilwell (Chelsea).
76' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just over the crossbar. It could have been a fantastic goal!
75' Anthony Taylor shows a yellow card to Axel Disasi (Chelsea) for his blatant foul.

75' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the bottom left corner, but Djordje Petrovic is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
73' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Djordje Petrovic anticipates well and smothers the ball.
72' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
72' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The referee signals a corner kick to Chelsea.
71' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but Djordje Petrovic comes off his line to gather the ball.
69' A rebound falls kindly for Levi Colwill (Chelsea), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
69' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
66' Here comes a substitution. Noni Madueke (Chelsea) is brought on as a substitute for Armando Broja.
64' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Kenny Tete will be replaced by Timothy Castagne (Fulham).
64' We are about to witness a subsitution. Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) for Harry Wilson.
61' Chelsea take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
60' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Chelsea will take a corner kick.
58' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Anthony Taylor had an easy-decision to make.
57' Chelsea take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
57' Armando Broja (Chelsea) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Chelsea force a corner. They send men into the box.
55' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
53' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar.
53' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) latches on to a superb cross into the box and hits the right post with his header. A stroke of luck for the goalkeeper!
49' Harry Wilson (Fulham) has tested the patience of referee Anthony Taylor and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
48' Tom Cairney (Fulham) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
48' Thiago Silva (Chelsea) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Fulham will take a free kick near the side line.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Cole Palmer (Chelsea) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Bernd Leno no chance!
45+4' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

45+2' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Issa Diop (Fulham). Anthony Taylor saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to Chelsea.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' The corner from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is cleared away by the defence.

45' Harry Wilson (Fulham) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Good work from Fulham as they win a corner.
44' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

44' Harry Wilson (Fulham) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Fulham.
42' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
41' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Fulham win a corner.
39' Willian (Fulham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
38' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Malo Gusto (Chelsea) was quite harsh and Anthony Taylor didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
38' Kenny Tete (Fulham) makes a rough challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Tom Cairney (Fulham) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
37' Fulham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
36' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
33' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) commits a rough foul. Anthony Taylor stops the game and makes a call.
33' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
31' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.

28' Djordje Petrovic was forced into action to thwart Harry Wilson (Fulham). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper.
26' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Djordje Petrovic was alert and made a comfortable save.
25' The corner from Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is intercepted by the defence.
25' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee points to the corner flag and Chelsea will take a corner.
23' Dangerous play by Thiago Silva (Chelsea). Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Armando Broja (Chelsea) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the left post.
20' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) commits a rough challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
16' Close! Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar.
15' Armando Broja (Chelsea) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
12' Wow, what an escape. Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
10' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
9' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Anthony Taylor has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
4' The free kick from Cole Palmer (Chelsea) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out.
2' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Chelsea will have the kick-off.
Anthony Taylor will referee today's match.
